answer.text: Make comparisons with similar, comparable products with full facts
Make negative statements about other Portfolio Managers or IAs

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Negative statements about other PMs/IAs are prohibited. **The Trap:** Comparisons with full facts ARE allowed. **Cross-Exam Context:** Same in X-B. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Comparisons must cite sources — screenshots and factsheets protect the distributor.
